home.title: Group draws
home.subtitle: Create an event, load each group's list (ID, Name, Subgroup) and draw. Works fully offline.
home.empty: No events yet. Create the first one above.
home.confirmDelete: Delete this event and all its results?

event.defaultsHint: Every group inherits these; you can customize them per group.
event.overlapNone: No ID appears in more than one group.
event.overlapText: The same ID appears in several groups. Nobody can win (or be an alternate) in more than one group: the group drawn first has priority.
event.noGroups: No groups yet. Create one or import files.
event.someDrawn: Some groups were already drawn. What do you want to do?
event.nothingToDraw: No group is ready to draw (check errors or empty lists).

group.name: Group name
group.pasteHint: One row per person: ID ⇥ Name ⇥ Subgroup (tab, ; or , separated). Headers are detected automatically.
group.empty: This group has no participants yet.
group.errorsHint: All three columns (ID, Name, Subgroup) are required. Fix each row or remove it; drawing is blocked while errors remain.
group.warnNameConflict: ID {{id}} appears with different names ({{names}}); the first one is kept.
group.warnMultiSub: ID {{id}} appears in several subgroups ({{subgroups}}); it can only be picked once in the group.
group.drawBlocked: Fix rejected rows and load participants to enable drawing.
group.confirmDeleteGroup: Delete this group and its result?

mapping.title: Map columns
mapping.name: Name
mapping.needAll: Assign a different column to ID, Name and Subgroup.

settings.dedupeHint: When off, a repeated ID has more tickets (better odds). When on: one ticket per ID.
settings.prizes: Prizes (one per line, in position order)
settings.bonusIds: IDs with an extra ticket (one per line)
settings.quotaHint: Set how many winners and alternates come from each subgroup.
settings.quotaIgnored: The totals above are ignored in this mode.

review.title: Review participants
review.shuffleHint: Only changes the on-screen order; it does not affect the result.
review.willDraw: {{w}} winners and {{a}} alternates will be drawn.
review.excluded: {{n}} IDs already won in other groups and are left out of this draw.

result.noEligible: No eligible participants left to replace with.

summary.title: Winners summary
summary.nothing: No group has been drawn yet.

verify.title: Verify draws
verify.intro: Recomputes every draw from the stored list, seed and exclusions and checks that it matches the original winners.

reason.list changed: the list changed after the draw

verify.replacementsNote: Recorded replacements: {{n}} (not recomputed; shown in the certificate).

present.hint: ← → or space to advance · Esc to exit
present.title: Presentation

cert.footer: Generated by Sorteos v{{v}}. Each draw can be recomputed from the list, the seed and the exclusions.
